name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 13 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 13 hours starting 2026-03-29, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
